# Kubernetes manifest and Helm template counters, for a rule with the prompt file-body-ops: one per
# line, label TAB pattern (Java regex). The [ignore] line blanks YAML comments, Helm comments
# ({{/* */}}, also with the - trim markers; one never closed runs to the end of the file) and the
# body of a block scalar (the lines below a | or > that are deeper than its key, past a list item's
# dash, as deep as the first of them; the key stays), so the image, ports and probes of a manifest
# a ConfigMap embeds do not count. "resources" counts a kind: at column 0 only. Helm renders a block
# scalar too, so "Helm control actions (approx)" (every if, else if, range, with, define, template,
# include and block action) and ".Values references" read the file as written ([raw]) and leave out
# only one in a comment: after a # at a line start or after a blank, or after a {{/* on its line,
# at most 200 and 300 characters before it. OpsFactPatternsTest pins every case;
# ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every pattern reads linearly.
[ignore] YAML and template comments, block scalars
resources
workloads
Services, Ingresses and Routes
ConfigMaps and Secrets
container images
container ports
probes
secret references
[raw] Helm control actions (approx)
[raw] .Values references
